voice.text: Sit upright. Half-lotus if it suits you, right leg on the left, hands palm-up, right on left. Or any steady seat.
voice.say: Sit upright. Half-lotus if it suits you, right leg on the left, hands palm-up, right on left. Or any steady seat.

voice.text: Body straight. Mind on the task in front of you.
voice.say: Body straight. Mind on the task in front of you.

voice.text: Bring your palms together in front of the heart, and recall the qualities of the Buddha, the Dhamma and the Sangha.
voice.say: Bring your palms together in front of the heart, and recall the qualities of the Buddha, the Dhamma and the Sangha.

voice.text: The Buddha is my mainstay.
voice.say: The Buddha is my mainstay.

quote.cite: Ajaan Lee Dhammadharo, Keeping the Breath in Mind, method-1:p1.s3 (tr. Ṭhānissaro Bhikkhu)

voice.text: The Dhamma is my mainstay.
voice.say: The Dhamma is my mainstay.

quote.cite: Ajaan Lee Dhammadharo, Keeping the Breath in Mind, method-1:p1.s4 (tr. Ṭhānissaro Bhikkhu)

voice.text: The Sangha is my mainstay.
voice.say: The Sangha is my mainstay.

quote.cite: Ajaan Lee Dhammadharo, Keeping the Breath in Mind, method-1:p1.s5 (tr. Ṭhānissaro Bhikkhu)

voice.text: In your mind: buddho, buddho. Dhammo, dhammo. Sangho, sangho.
voice.say: In your mind. Buddho, buddho. Dhammo, dhammo. Sangho, sangho.

voice.text: Hands back in your lap. Silently, three times: buddho.
voice.say: Hands back in your lap. Silently, three times: buddho.

voice.text: Breathing in, think “bud”…
voice.say: Breathing in: bud.

voice.text: …breathing out, “dho”. Ten breaths, at your own pace.
voice.say: …breathing out, “dho”. Ten breaths, at your own pace.

voice.text: Now “buddho” on the in-breath…
voice.say: Now “buddho” on the in-breath…

voice.text: …and “buddho” on the out-breath. Seven breaths.
voice.say: …and “buddho” on the out-breath. Seven breaths.

voice.text: Now one “buddho” for each whole breath, in and out. Five breaths.
voice.say: Now one “buddho” for each whole breath, in and out. Five breaths.

voice.text: Now “buddho” three times in each breath. Three breaths.
voice.say: Now “buddho” three times in each breath. Three breaths.

voice.text: Stop counting. Just “bud” on the in-breath, “dho” on the out.
voice.say: Stop counting. Just “bud” on the in-breath, “dho” on the out.

voice.text: Let the breath be relaxed and natural.
voice.say: Let the breath be relaxed and natural.

voice.text: Keep the mind still, with the breath at the nostrils.
voice.say: Keep the mind still, with the breath at the nostrils.

voice.text: As it goes out, don't send the mind out after it. As it comes in, don't follow it in.
voice.say: As it goes out, don't send the mind out after it. As it comes in, don't follow it in.

voice.text: Let your awareness be broad, cheerful, and open.
voice.say: Let your awareness be broad, cheerful, and open.

voice.text: Don't force the mind. Relax.
voice.say: Don't force the mind. Relax.

voice.text: Imagine you're breathing out into the wide open air.
voice.say: Imagine you're breathing out into the wide open air.

voice.text: Be like a post at the edge of the sea. The tide rises and falls; the post doesn't move.
voice.say: Be like a post at the edge of the sea. The tide rises and falls; the post doesn't move.

voice.text: Bud… dho. Still, like the post.
voice.say: Bud… dho. Still, like the post.

voice.text: When you're this still, let go of “buddho”.
voice.say: When you're this still, let go of “buddho”.

voice.text: Simply feel the breath itself.
voice.say: Simply feel the breath itself.

voice.text: Now inward: the tip of the nose…
voice.say: Now inward: the tip of the nose…

voice.text: …and slowly up to the middle of the forehead.
voice.say: …and slowly up to the middle of the forehead.

voice.text: Keep your awareness broad.
voice.say: Keep your awareness broad.

voice.text: Rest a moment at the forehead, then come back to the nose.
voice.say: Rest a moment at the forehead, then come back to the nose.

voice.text: Now back and forth, nose to forehead, like climbing up and down a mountain. Seven times.
voice.say: Now back and forth, nose to forehead, like climbing up and down a mountain. Seven times.

voice.text: Settle at the forehead. Don't go back to the nose.
voice.say: Settle at the forehead. Don't go back to the nose.

voice.text: Move up to the middle of the top of the head, and settle there.
voice.say: Move up to the middle of the top of the head, and settle there.

voice.text: Breathe in there; let it spread through the head…
voice.say: Breathe in there; let it spread through the head…

voice.text: …then return to the forehead.
voice.say: …then return to the forehead.

voice.text: Back and forth between the forehead and the top of the head. Seven times.
voice.say: Back and forth between the forehead and the top of the head. Seven times.

voice.text: Finally, rest on the top of the head.
voice.say: Finally, rest on the top of the head.

voice.text: Now into the centre of the brain…
voice.say: Now into the centre of the brain…

voice.text: …be still a moment, then back to the top of the head.
voice.say: …be still a moment, then back to the top of the head.

voice.text: Back and forth between these two spots: the top, and the middle.
voice.say: Back and forth between these two spots: the top, and the middle.

voice.text: Finally, settle in the middle of the brain.
voice.say: Finally, settle in the middle of the brain.

voice.text: Keep your awareness broad.
voice.say: Keep your awareness broad.

voice.text: Let the refined breath in the head spread down to the lower body.
voice.say: Let the refined breath in the head spread down to the lower body.

voice.text: Keep awareness still and expansive. Let the refined breath fill the whole body.
voice.say: Keep awareness still and expansive. Let the refined breath fill the whole body.

voice.text: Stay with the whole body breathing, as long as you like.
voice.say: Stay with the whole body breathing, as long as you like.

markers.label: The post at the edge of the sea
Just the feeling of the breath

contraindications: Don't force the mind. If signs appear (lights, heat, tingling), don't be affected; breathe deep and long down into the heart and they go.
Most people find Method 2 easier and more relaxing; start there if this feels effortful.
